detections.original: HOW ABOUT IT? WANT TO COME WITH US?
detections.translated: Alors, ça te dit de venir avec nous ?

detections.original: I ALREADY SAID NO.
detections.translated: J'ai déjà dit non.

detections.original: KID, YOU DON'T UNDER STAND THE RULES OF THE WILDERNESS.
detections.translated: Mec, tu piges rien aux règles de la nature.

detections.original: IT'S MORE DANGEROUS OUT HERE AT NIGHT THAN YOU CAN IMAGINE.
detections.translated: C'est bien plus dangereux ici la nuit que tu ne l'imagines.

detections.original: RIGHT NOW, I HAVE NO US ABLE SKILLS. I HAVE TO AVOID DIRECT CONFRONTATION...
detections.translated: Pour l'instant, j'ai aucune compétence utile. Je dois éviter la confrontation directe...

detections.original: I'M A SUMMONER. I DON'T NEED COMPANIONS.
detections.translated: Je suis un invocateur. J'ai pas besoin de compagnie.

detections.original: IF THERE'S ANY DANGER, I CAN JUST SUMMON AN ELEMENTAL CREATURE TO DEAL WITH IT.
detections.translated: S'il y a le moindre danger, j'ai qu'à invoquer une créature élémentaire pour régler ça.

detections.original: CONCERN FOR YOUR SAFETYV WAS UNNECESSARY,KID!

detections.original: PERHAPS...

detections.original: WE'LL MEET AGAIN, HAND SOME.
detections.translated: On se reverra, beau gosse.

detections.original: BYE BYE!

detections.original: DESPICABLE. EVEN IF THE WILDERNESS IS DANGEROUS,IT'S STILL SAFER THAN BEING BACKSTABBED BY MATERIAL HUNTERS!
detections.translated: Dégoûtant. Même si la nature est dangereuse, c'est toujours plus sûr que de se faire poignarder dans le dos par des chasseurs de matériaux !

detections.original: HAA...I SUPPOSE THIS IS THE RESULT OF HAVING NO STRENGTH.

detections.original: I NEED TO HURRY UP AND GET GOING.
